label: Synpath
about: Tick-level Kalshi order book and trade history, and cross-venue market matching. Signing in with your Google account creates the company's API key.
expiredHint: Synpath's management sign-in has expired (the API key it created may still work). Reconnect to sign in again.

knownIssues.title: Google refuses the sign-in
knownIssues.match: access_denied|access blocked|test user|not completed the Google verification|403
knownIssues.text: While Synpath's Google app is in testing, only Google accounts on its test-user list can sign in. If Google says access is blocked, ask Synpath to add your Google account as a test user, then Connect again.

notes: synpath login (synpath/hosted_auth.py) listens on 127.0.0.1 at a random port, named as cli_port in the sign-in address, for /callback?code=...&state=<cli_state>. It has --no-browser but no device flow, so a remote owner uses the paste fallback or an SSH tunnel. SYNPATH_CREDENTIALS_FILE moves its credentials.json (0600) into the company's connections folder.
